messages:
maria: Heads-up — RC2 cut in ~6h. Need quick eyes on these PRs before we open the merge gate:
1) https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/1234 (perf fix, needs changelog)
2) https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/1235 (needs backport to v1.2)
3) https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/1236 (merge conflict + flaky test)
Please comment / approve if you can, and call who will handle backports. Tagging @sam @jen @leo. Thanks!

sam: On it. I'll take 1234 and 1236. ETA ~30m.

jen: I can do the backport for 1235 to v1.2. Will open the cherry-pick PR and fix any conflicts.

leo: Quick glance at 1234 — perf numbers look promising. Left one nit in the diff about a renamed var.

sam: Thanks. Pushed an update for 1236 to address the test flake, PTAL @maria.

maria: Added the 'needs-changelog' label to 1234. Please add a one-line changelog to the PR description, e.g., `reduce tokenization overhead in batch path`.

deploy-bot: CI: 1234 — all checks passing. 1235 (backport branch) — lint failing. 1236 — flaky test rerun in progress.

jen: Opened backport PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/1240 (cherry-pick of 1235). Lint failing due to import order, fixing now.

sam: LGTM on 1234 after nit addressed, approving.

leo: I can help word the changelog: "fix: reduce tokenization overhead in batch path (low-latency improvement)" — thoughts?

maria: That's clear. Add that to the top of PR description and mark with `release-note` label.

sam: Current approvals: 1234 ✅. 1236 needs one more approval from eng-sre before we merge. @kyle can you weigh in on 1236?

kyle: Happy to review 1236. Looking now.

kyle: Found the flake root — a race in the test teardown. Suggest adding a short sync in the fixture, will push a tiny patch.

sam: Great. Once kyle pushes, I'll re-run CI and merge if green.

maria: Also: please confirm backport PR 1240 is lint-green before we include it in the cut. If not, we'll hold it and include in the next patch.

michelle: FYI marketing — if you add the `release-note` label I will pick up the PRs and draft the release blurb. Thanks!

deploy-bot: Merge window scheduled at 2026-03-20T16:00Z. Cut will start at 2026-03-20T16:30Z unless held.

maria: Perfect. Plan: aim to have all merges by 16:15Z. If CI still failing for any of the critical PRs at 16:15Z, we hold the cut and requeue. Keep posting status here.

sam: Will update this thread when CI is green and merges happen. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround.
